description: Check whether a specific open-weight model fits on a specific GPU: VRAM required, whether it fits, how much headroom, which quantization to use, and an estimated decode speed in tokens/sec. Use for questions like 'can an RTX 4090 run Llama 70B'.

gpu.description: GPU id or name, e.g. 'rtx4090'. Call list_gpus to see options.

model.description: Local model id or name, e.g. 'llama33-70b'. Call list_local_models to see options.

quant.description: Quantization id (default 'q4'), e.g. q4, q5, q8, fp16.

name: can_i_run_model
